page.notes: The left-hand strip shows show-through and neighbouring-page edge, not transcribed. Several numerals in the date column are uncertain (e.g. 4916, 4954, 1980, 4997, 5021 read as printed). The left margin holds the numbers 38, 26, 17, 24 and 35, each set beside a line of the column at its height; they are printed as marginal references and are given here as notes: 38 (beside 4913), 26 (beside 4921), 17 (beside 4957), 24 (beside 4982), 35 (beside 5034). The numerals 4883 and 5024, 5026 are partly cut at the right edge; the letters of the column heading are small capitals. Readings of the figures are as seen and may be uncertain. The table's left and right columns are marginal numbers belonging to the entries beside them. The bottom-left "Ee" is a gathering signature and the bottom-right "Anni" is a catchword. The page is cut off at its top and bottom edges, so the first line may be a fragment.
